market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both closed higher, influenced by better-than-expected third-quarter earnings reports from companies like Tesla and IBM. Additionally, investors have reportedly propelled the healthcare sector to a record high, contributing to the overall positive market sentiment.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, declined. This movement likely reflects a decrease in market uncertainty, consistent with the positive earnings reports from major companies such as Tesla and IBM that contributed to the rise in major stock indices.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: Meta announced plans to issue a new class of shares to help fund its artificial intelligence initiatives, alongside potential acquisitions and employee compensation.
Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, a new AI agent designed for professionals and small business owners, launching as a research preview available on standalone apps and Claude on the web.
OpenAI's latest AI models, including GPT 6.1 Astra, Sol, and Luna, are expected to be integrated into Google Cloud and Antigravity in the coming weeks.

world.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin ordered the release of American Stephen Hubbard from prison after a request from President Trump, occurring during meetings aimed at resuming Ukraine peace talks.
Meta has been ordered to pay a $25 billion fine by a judge in New Mexico for privacy violations related to user data, marking the largest penalty to date against Facebook's owner.
House prices are falling across every Australian capital city for the first time in 15 years, with Sydney experiencing a 4.7% drop in the September quarter to a two-year low.
A Canadian publisher, Boreal, has severed ties with best-selling Haitian-Canadian writer Thelyson Orelien after investigations confirmed he used AI in his breakthrough novel.

us.summary: The Supreme Court has upheld a pause on the Trump administration's policy regarding gender-affirming care for inmates in federal prisons, requiring its continuation as litigation proceeds.
The FAA has cleared the way for airlines to put Boeing's 737 Max 10 into service, nearly a decade after the largest 737 Max jet was unveiled.

A United Nations report indicates that the U.S. was the only major economy to experience a dramatic increase in planet-warming pollution last year, a development the UN warns could lead to catastrophic warming.

science.summary: New human data suggests that psychedelics like psilocybin have the potential to lower inflammation, which could be protective for patients with neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson's.
Test results have confirmed that Pope Francis's diagnosis following lung cancer surgery was a localized lung adenocarcinoma, and he does not require further treatment.
